New York, NY
Dev – Environment Platform
Full-time / Hybrid

A World-Changing Company
Palantir builds the world's leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
Our Environment Platform team architects the containerization strategy across Palantir's software platforms (Foundry, Gotham and Apollo) and extends it to our customer base. You will build elegant, robust APIs powered by K8s controllers which bridge the gap between a raw Kubernetes cluster and a fully-featured, infrastructure agnostic runtime that can scale to the operational needs of 100s of specialized microservices.

Core Responsibilities
Internalize our infrastructure strategy and the needs of our customers.
Leverage Kubernetes primitives and the open-source ecosystem to solve critical problems.
Build APIs that let developers interact with Kubernetes while abstracting away its complexity.
Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver sustainable technical solutions.
Champion long-term roadmaps with an emphasis on operational efficiency and scalability.

What We Value
Clear communication.
Impact-focused work with articulated value.
Experience developing and managing distributed systems.
API design expertise.
Deep familiarity with Kubernetes and its ecosystem.

What We Require
3+ years of professional software development experience.
1+ years contributing to system design and architecture.
1+ years mentoring or providing technical leadership.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, or an equivalent language.
Experience with high-scale observability or infrastructure systems.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Salary
$135,000 - $200,000 a year, plus RSUs, a sign-on bonus and other incentives.
